messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High p95 latency observed for corp-sierra (dedicated-vpc pool). Automated health checks show elevated queueing at inference-proxy and a spike in model tail latency. Observability: traces for corp-sierra are not appearing in the central APM — suspected per-tenant forwarder permission errors.

maria.sre: paging on-call for infra. I see the spike in the dashboard. Confirming: corp-sierra has dedicated GPUs in us-west-2-d; logging/trace forwarder shows 403 on trace writes.

tara-ps: corp-sierra alerted us via support. They can reproduce high latency on their side and asked for status. We need to confirm customer impact and provide ETA.

ajay.platform: looking now — the forwarder role binding to the customer VPC role was revoked during yesterday's infra cleanup job. Likely accidental. That would explain missing traces/logs.

leo-eng: can we grant a temporary allow-listed principal to pull traces? corp-sierra opted into strict log-siloing which requires an explicit service account binding to their forwarder.

maria.sre: action plan: 1) get temporary read-access to corp-sierra trace bucket and forwarder logs; 2) rebind forwarder SA so traces resume; 3) if traces can't be restored quickly, failover traffic to hosted fallback pool to reduce customer latency. Who can do the rebind now?

ajay.platform: I can do the IAM change. Need approval from security for a 1-hour emergency exception to rebind service account to corp-sierra-log-forwarder.

ops-bot: Security approval required: request /sec-exception --auto. (Automated note).

tara-ps: I'll message corp-sierra support to ask for ERT approval to proceed with temporary binding (we have delegation in the contract). Copying their security contact.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4532 (per-tenant observability gap). Priority: P1-customer-impact. Bridge: #incident-bridge-4532.

maria.sre: bridging now. Joining: maria.sre, ajay.platform, leo-eng, tara-ps. corp-sierra-support please join if available.

corp-sierra-support: joining. We can approve temporary binding for 45 minutes. Need a short summary for our security team.

maria.sre: summary: temporary rebind of Redwood-forwarder-sa to corp-sierra-log-forwarder role for 45 minutes to restore trace/log streaming for debugging. No logs will be copied outside corp-sierra VPC; binding limited to forwarder write role.

ajay.platform: running commands — attaching snippet:

```
# grant forwarder write role (one-off, emergency)
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding \ 
  redwood-forwarder-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \ 
  --member="serviceAccount:corp-sierra-forwarder@corp-sierra.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \ 
  --role="roles/logging.writer"
```

ajay.platform: applying now. will monitor logs for 1-2 mins.

leo-eng: while that runs, we should prep fallback: update routing policy for corp-sierra to route 10% of traffic to hosted-pool-2 as a gradual mitigation in case binding fails. Use canary route.

maria.sre: agreed. tara, can you coordinate the message to the customer indicating we're performing a temporary binding + canary routing? Keep it high level: restoring telemetry and reducing latency.

tara-ps: message drafted and sent. corp-sierra acknowledged and approved. They prefer we avoid full migration to hosted pool unless necessary.

ajay.platform: IAM change succeeded. I see trace events starting to appear in the forwarder logs. Confirming traces arriving in the central APM for corp-sierra now. :thumbsup:

maria.sre: nice — are logs complete enough to find root cause?

leo-eng: early look shows a large number of KV-cache misses on the dedicated pool that correlate with model weight swap events. Could be memory pressure on the pool. Not directly a telemetry problem but the missing traces prevented earlier diagnosis.

maria.sre: next steps: 1) keep IAM binding for 45 mins per customer approval, 2) run deeper memory profiling on dedicated pool nodes, 3) if pressure persists, throttle corp-sierra peak throughput and shift a portion of traffic to hosted fallback.

t+20m ajay.platform: profiling started. memory allocations spike around warmup windows. Uploading traces to incident bridge.

corp-sierra-support: we see request latencies normalizing for now after partial routing. Thank you.

maria.sre: handing off to ajay for next 2 hours to do mitigation and rollback plan. I'll log a post-incident ticket for cleanup: verify no other SA bindings were altered during cleanup job and add test to infra pipeline.

incident-bot: on-call handoff: from maria.sre -> ajay.platform at 1865432360.

ajay.platform: taking on-call. will keep the bridge open and post updates. assigning follow-ups: TRACE-144 (restore permanent binding workflow), OBS-312 (add test), POOL-98 (investigate memory pressure).

maria.sre: thanks team. tagging security to review emergency exception audit. :lock:

ops-bot: Audit note recorded: emergency IAM exception for redwood-forwarder-sa -> corp-sierra-forwarder (45m) by ajay.platform.

leo-eng: quick reminder — add a synthetic trace in corp-sierra sandbox to validate future post-deploy changes.

ajay.platform: will do. I'll update this thread with final status when mitigation is complete.

corp-sierra-support: appreciate the quick response. We'll keep an eye and escalate if anything else crops up.

maria.sre: closing initial surge response. last logs show traces flowing and p95 trending down. Move to postmortem and action items. :white_check_mark:
